commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.

90+9' 4 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Inaki Williams picks out an unmarked Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom right corner. 4:2.
90+8' Problems for Luis Castro as Kareem Tunde (Levante) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Paco Cortes replaces him.
90+8' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch so that Nico Serrano can be given a rest.
90+5' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

90+4' 3 - 2 Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 3:2.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Yellow card. Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
86' 3 - 1 Goal! Selton Sanchez slips a clever pass through to Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
81' 2 - 1 GOAL! Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 2:1.
81' Here comes a substitution. Iker Losada (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Ugo Raghouber.
80' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Levante win a corner kick.
80' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

79' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee points to the corner flag and Ath Bilbao will take a corner.
77' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
76' Substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off.
76' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Nico Williams will be replaced by Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao).
74' The attendance for today's match is 46487.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

73' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Mathew Ryan. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
72' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

68' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
68' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
66' What was Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
65' Luis Castro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) replacing Pablo Martinez Andres.
65' It's time for a substitution. Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) comes on in place of Dela.
65' Luis Castro has decided to substitute Ivan Romero and he is replaced by Carlos Espi (Levante).
63' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Mikel Jauregizar is replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gorka Guruzeta leaves the pitch and Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
61' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
58' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Levante in a dangerous position.
53' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathew Ryan, who smothers the ball.

52' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Levante.
48' Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight and sees a foul from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao). A free kick has been awarded to Levante.
47' Luis Castro has decided to make a change. Paco Cortes (Levante) replaces Kareem Tunde.
46' Half-time substitution. Luis Castro decided to make a change. Carlos Alvarez is replaced by Kervin Arriaga (Levante).
46' Referee Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Dela (Levante) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Kareem Tunde (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Unai Simon comes off his line to gather the ball.

44' That's unlucky! Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
42' Although Luis Castro (Levante) is just on the bench, Alejandro Ruiz has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

41' Ivan Romero (Levante) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
40' The referee signals a corner kick to Levante.
39' Yuri Berchiche is being substituted because of an injury. Ernesto Valverde sends Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) on the pitch.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.
37' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

34' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao). Inaki Williams plays a fantastic through ball and finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.

29' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Mathew Ryan was helpless.
27' Dela (Levante) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Levante have a free kick.
26' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Levante get a free kick.
22' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
19' The free kick from close range, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Alan Matturro (Levante) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

17' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
15' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

11' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Ath Bilbao are awarded the free kick.

9' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
8' Dangerous play by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao). Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Levante, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
5' Neat passing move from Ath Bilbao in order to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
1' The match has just started.
Ath Bilbao will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Ruiz.
